name: p18-marketplace
description: Real, tested geometric data-addressing tools: byte-pair geo compression and an offline tiered-confidence response cache.

plugins.name: p18-tools
plugins.description: Real byte-pair geo compression (usually loses to gzip, including on embedding data) and an offline tiered-confidence response cache with export/import to share it across machines.

plugins.name: ollama-tools
plugins.description: Query a local Ollama model, embed text, or compare a local model's answer against Claude's own, all against a real local Ollama instance.

plugins.name: hdl-tools
plugins.description: Simulate Verilog with Icarus Verilog, synthesize with Yosys for real gate counts/critical-path/timing, and dump real VCD waveforms via GTKWave.

plugins.name: bin-inspect
plugins.description: Real hex dump, entropy, ELF header, compression comparison, disassembly, byte-level diffing, and multi-algorithm checksums for any file.

plugins.name: prime-utils
plugins.description: Deterministic primality testing, factorization, sieving, and a real mod-18 prime-gap-residue check confirmed to 300,000,000 with an exact parity-based explanation.
